branding.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished store cover/key art for the original pixel-art military RTS game 钢铁黎明 / IRON DAWN. Generate a premium, beautifully art-directed 4:3 landscape cover, exactly 1280x960 pixels. Rich deliberate pixel clusters, hard square edges and restrained dithering, like an exceptionally crafted 1990s industrial strategy-game cover rendered at 640x480 and cleanly enlarged 2x. The scene and typography should feel cohesive, polished and original.
Scene: a northern industrial outpost at dawn, teal-grey smoke giving way to a narrow amber sunrise. Layered isometric terrain, a stone river crossing, wet fractured concrete roads, amber mineral crystals, steel pipes, warning stripes, radio aerials and warmly lit workshop doors. The home base has mint reactor caps and twin pale cooling stacks, a tiered headquarters with a teal glass roof, a small dish, and an olive arched-roof barracks. A distant dark grey communications fortress is visible through atmospheric smoke.
Hero composition: the lower half is anchored by one substantial low olive-green tracked battle tank in three-quarter isometric view, sloping armor, compact turret, segmented treads, pale steel edge highlights, two mint identification slashes, white headlamps, short radio antenna and exactly ONE clean continuous cannon barrel. It faces to the right and protects two small helmeted infantry with dark teal visors and clearly readable two-handed rifle poses. Behind it, one longer tracked artillery vehicle has a triangular support and exactly ONE long elevated cannon tube with an amber muzzle brake, never forked. A small amber mining truck carries glowing ore toward the base farther back. A few tiny coral enemy lights and one distant shell explosion establish the conflict. Keep weapon mechanics coherent: any muzzle flash comes from the tip of a single barrel. Strong readable silhouettes; no busy swarm.
Branding: keep a calm dark upper-quarter sky for the title. The ONLY words in the entire image are the exact large Chinese title "钢铁黎明" and the exact smaller English subtitle "IRON DAWN" directly below it. Readable, finely designed geometric pixel lettering, pale ivory steel faces, olive bevel shadows, subtle mint edge accents and tiny amber highlights. To the left of the title integrate a compact original shield emblem: an amber rising sun above a factory skyline and two pale steel downward chevrons. The title occupies roughly 75% of the cover width and stays clear of the outer 6% safety margin. The artwork remains the hero, with space separating the title from the scene.
Palette: dark blue-slate shadows, olive armor, cream metal edges, mint-teal allied marks and reactor lights, warm amber dawn and ore, restrained coral enemy accents. Atmospheric depth without blurry pixel edges. Dramatic cinematic light, coherent upper-left highlights, carefully readable detail at thumbnail size. Edge-to-edge rectangular artwork; opaque background. No additional slogans, descriptive captions, badges, stars, UI panels, screenshots, pricing, grids, watermarks, existing franchise marks, duplicated barrels, photorealism, glossy 3D rendering or blurry airbrush.

Use case: logo-brand. Create a production-ready raster title logo asset for the original pixel-art industrial RTS game 钢铁黎明 / IRON DAWN. True transparent background. Wide horizontal composition approximately 4:1, tightly framed but keep 5% empty padding, no mockup, no scene, no extra labels. The exact Chinese title "钢铁黎明" is the dominant wordmark in meticulously designed bold geometric pixel lettering, highly readable and spelled exactly. Add the exact smaller English subtitle "IRON DAWN". A compact angular shield / twin chevrons / rising sun emblem sits to the left, integrated with the wordmark. Brushed pale steel beveled letter faces with olive shadows, narrow mint-teal edge accents, tiny amber sunrise highlights. Dark slate shadow outlining makes the mark readable over a dark game scene. Original late-1990s premium pixel RTS title aesthetic; deliberate pixel clusters and sharp edges, no blurry glow, no photographic texture, no existing franchise logos. The logo must work when displayed at 380x100 game pixels. Keep the title and emblem in one cohesive horizontal silhouette.

Use case: logo-brand. Generate one polished ORIGINAL square pixel-art app icon for the industrial isometric RTS game Iron Dawn, designed to read clearly at 96x96 pixels. A low olive-green armored tank with ONE single cannon, mint-teal identifying slashes and pale metal highlights, viewed isometrically above a stylized amber rising sun and angular mint chevron shield. A dark slate metal tile fills the square edge to edge, beveled cut corners inside the square, strong simple central silhouette, restrained highlights, 16-24 color clustered pixel shading. No text, no letters, no external margins, no rounded outer corners, no grid, no multiple variants. The entire canvas is the icon. Premium classic pixel RTS craftsmanship, clean visual hierarchy, no brand from any existing game.

Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a production-ready pixel UI icon atlas, transparent background. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, sixteen equal square cells, each centered on the same regular grid with generous transparent padding. Canvas square. NO text, labels, frames, borders, shadows on the canvas, or extra symbols. Each icon is a crisp compact silhouette designed at a native 24x24 pixel grid, shown enlarged with square pixel clusters. Consistent mint-teal and pale steel highlights, dark slate outlines, amber accents; STOP is coral red, ore is amber. Row 1 left to right: [pause symbol two parallel bars], [solid red stop square], [mint repair wrench], [mint top-down aircraft silhouette]. Row 2: [magnifying glass with plus], [crossed cancel X], [two stacked chevrons for infantry], [small isometric military headquarters building]. Row 3: [three grouped chevrons for select all], [return-to-base arrow pointing into a small base], [four dashed selection rectangle corners], [closed padlock]. Row 4: [amber ore crystal cluster], [electric lightning bolt], [small speaker with sound waves], [small five-point veteran star]. Match an olive/slate industrial pixel RTS interface. Keep every item fully within its own cell and aligned. Only the sixteen requested icons.

world.prompt: Rework the provided Iron Dawn design reference into a production sprite atlas of matching industrial buildings. True transparent background. All viewed in the SAME fixed 2:1 isometric camera, front faces toward bottom-left and bottom-right, upper-left lighting. Crisp pixel art at a native 96x96-pixel game footprint, enlarged with square pixels, olive/slate metal, pale steel edges, mint team slashes and amber hazard accents. Keep the detailed classic pixel RTS craftsmanship of the reference. Row1: [headquarters with layered roofs, large teal glass roof, tall thin radio antenna and small dish], [fusion power station with twin pale cylindrical cooling stacks and glowing teal reactor caps], [ore refinery with vents, amber processing hopper and a low loading conveyor], [infantry barracks with olive arched roof, recessed doors and a small striped watch post]. No text, labels, grid lines, people, buildings or cast shadows. Use muted desaturated olive moss #46533a, dark slate earth #293b36, warm small gravel specks #65715a, and deep blue-green water #1c4850.
